proof_body:
by
  intro K _ _ d s h2 hs hns a b
  have hli : LinearIndependent ℚ ![(1 : K), s] := by
    rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
    intro c e hce
    by_cases he : e = 0
    · subst he; simp at hce; exact ⟨hce, rfl⟩
    · exfalso
      apply hns
      refine ⟨-c / e, ?_⟩
      have : (e : ℚ) • s = -(c • (1 : K)) := by
        have := hce; rw [add_comm] at this; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left this
      have he' : algebraMap ℚ K e ≠ 0 := by simpa using he
      rw [map_div₀, map_neg, div_eq_iff he', mul_comm]
      simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using this.symm
  let B : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℚ K := basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank hli (by simp [h2])
  have hB0 : B 0 = 1 := by simp [B]
  have hB1 : B 1 = s := by simp [B]
  let x : K := algebraMap ℚ K a + algebraMap ℚ K b * s
  have e0 : x * B 0 = a • B 0 + b • B 1 := by
    simp [x, hB0, hB1, Algebra.smul_def]
  have e1 : x * B 1 = (b * d) • B 0 + a • B 1 := by
    simp only [x, hB0, hB1, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, add_mul, mul_one]
    rw [mul_assoc, hs]; ring
  have hM : Algebra.leftMulMatrix B x = !![a, b * d; b, a] := by
    ext i j
    rw [Algebra.leftMulMatrix_eq_repr_mul]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · simp [e0]
    · simp [e1]
    · simp [e0]
    · simp [e1]
  constructor
  · change Algebra.trace ℚ K x = _
    rw [Algebra.trace_eq_matrix_trace B, hM, Matrix.trace_fin_two]; simp; ring
  · change Algebra.norm ℚ x = _
    rw [Algebra.norm_eq_matrix_det B, hM, Matrix.det_fin_two]; simp; ring
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (d : ℚ) (s : K), Module.finrank ℚ K = 2 → s * s = algebraMap ℚ K d → s ∉ Set.range (algebraMap ℚ K) → ∀ a b : ℚ, Algebra.trace ℚ K (algebraMap ℚ K a + algebraMap ℚ K b * s) = 2 * a ∧ Algebra.norm ℚ (algebraMap ℚ K a + algebraMap ℚ K b * s) = a ^ 2 - d * b ^ 2
